policies.content.description: Rules for using design templates and creative assets.
policies.content.sections.1.text: Creators must have valid rights to the designs, images, audio, fonts, and assets they upload. Publishing a template does not transfer intellectual property ownership to other users.
policies.content.sections.1.title: 1. Rights to designs
policies.content.sections.2.text: Buyers and users may edit only the parts the template allows them to change. Creating a gift from a template does not automatically grant rights to extract, resell, or distribute its original components.
policies.content.sections.2.title: 2. Personalization scope
policies.content.sections.3.text: Senders are responsible for having permission to share photos, names, greetings, and recipient information. Do not upload someone else's private data without an appropriate basis.
policies.content.sections.3.title: 3. User uploads
policies.content.sections.4.text: If a template or gift appears to infringe copyright, send the link, a description of the issue, and supporting evidence through Contact support so we can review it.
policies.content.sections.4.title: 4. Reporting infringement
policies.content.title: Content and copyright
policies.draft: These policies are still being drafted. Operator details and legal review are required before they take effect.
policies.general.description: Rules for using the Momevia digital gifting platform.
policies.general.sections.1.text: Momevia lets you browse templates and personalize, create, and share digital gifts by link. Some features, including template purchases and creator payouts, are still being developed and are not commercially available.
policies.general.sections.1.title: 1. Scope of service
policies.general.sections.2.text: Keep your sign-in details secure, provide appropriate information, and obtain permission before using someone else's account. Contact support if you notice unusual access.
policies.general.sections.2.title: 2. User accounts
policies.general.sections.3.text: Do not upload fraudulent or harassing content, content that violates privacy or intellectual property rights, or unlawful content. Senders may use only photos, music, and personal information they have permission to share.
policies.general.sections.3.title: 3. Permitted content
policies.general.sections.4.text: Anyone with the link may access the gift depending on its current settings. Avoid putting sensitive information in a gift. Having the link does not establish the recipient's identity.
policies.general.sections.4.title: 4. Gift links
policies.general.sections.5.text: Momevia may hide content temporarily or ask for changes if it appears to violate these rules. We will publish full complaint and dispute procedures before commercial launch.
policies.general.sections.5.title: 5. Suspension and content review
policies.general.title: General terms and policies
policies.helpDescription: Contact support with questions about the policies or to report content.
policies.payment.description: Information about template prices, payment status, and procedures in development.
policies.payment.sections.1.text: Momevia has not activated online payments. Prices shown on certain templates are indicative and reflect planned features. Activating access to a template currently does not involve a real payment.
policies.payment.sections.1.title: 1. Current payment status
policies.payment.sections.2.text: Before real payments become available, Momevia will show the total price, template license, how long the gift will be available, and any additional fees before the buyer confirms the order.
policies.payment.sections.2.title: 2. Prices and service fees
policies.payment.sections.3.text: When payment providers are integrated, an order is completed only after Momevia receives and verifies a valid payment notification from the provider. A screenshot of a transfer is insufficient to confirm an order.
policies.payment.sections.3.title: 3. Confirming transactions
policies.payment.sections.4.text: There have been no real transactions on the platform, so no actual refund requests have arisen. Refund eligibility, processing times, and contact details will be defined before sales officially open.
policies.payment.sections.4.title: 4. Cancellations and refunds
policies.payment.sections.5.text: If you have trouble with a template or creating a gift, send a request using the Contact support form. Keep card details, one-time codes, and passwords out of support requests.
policies.payment.sections.5.title: 5. Support
policies.payment.title: Payment policy
policies.privacy.description: How Momevia handles account, gift, and reply data.
policies.privacy.sections.1.text: When you register or use the service, you may provide your name, email, credentials, personalization photos, greetings, recipient names, replies, and support request content. If you use Google or Zalo, the provider may share profile data based on the permissions you grant.
policies.privacy.sections.1.title: 1. Data you may provide
policies.privacy.sections.2.text: We use data to authenticate accounts, save favorites, create and display gifts, store replies, support users, and resolve issues. Recipients currently do not need to create an account just to open a gift.
policies.privacy.sections.2.title: 2. How we use data
policies.privacy.sections.3.text: Anyone with a valid gift link can view the content the sender published. Consider the information and photos in a gift before sharing it. QR codes are generated on your device without sending the gift link to an external QR service. Signing in via Google or Zalo may connect you to the respective provider.
policies.privacy.sections.3.title: 3. Sharing and access
policies.privacy.sections.4.text: For email accounts, passwords are stored as salted hashes. The original passwords are not stored. Sign-in sessions use HttpOnly cookies. Storage, backups, retention periods, and access controls require further work before we offer the service publicly.
policies.privacy.sections.4.title: 4. Storage and security
policies.privacy.sections.5.text: Contact support to correct information, report unauthorized access, or request action on your data. During this stage, we confirm how to handle each request on a case-by-case basis.
policies.privacy.sections.5.title: 5. Data requests

templates.ban-do-ngay-ra-truong.previewM: The first day in class, a new backpack, and friends whose names we had yet to learn. A little nervous, and full of curiosity.
Late study sessions and that first presentation. A little fear each time, and a little more confidence because we had each other.
Today we close a beautiful chapter, carrying our curiosity, friendships, and unfinished dreams into what comes next.
templates.afterglow.previewMessage: After a long day, may you find a quiet moment to look ahead. I am here beside you for all the good that is still to come.
templates.calm-light.previewMessage: You have been trying so hard. Take a slower moment today, rest, and make room for something that brings you peace.
templates.cloud-nine.previewMessage: May your heart feel light today. Someone is thinking of you and smiling at the things we have shared.
templates.confetti.previewMessage: Today is yours! May this new year of your life bring close friends, lovely surprises, and memories worth keeping.
templates.faraway-hug.previewMessage: Even from another city, I am sending you the closest hug. Until we meet again and tell each other everything.
templates.gentle-apology.previewMessage: I am sorry for hurting you. I want to listen and understand what you need. Take the time you need. We can talk when you feel ready.
templates.greenhouse.previewMessage: May the things you care for keep growing, day by day. Even when progress feels slow, every small step deserves to be seen.
templates.lavender.previewMessage: Some ordinary days stay with me simply because you were there. Sending you a little gentleness from the memories we share.
templates.love-letter.previewMessage: With you beside me, ordinary things become memories. Thank you for being here, listening, and sharing these little days with me.
templates.midnight-bloom.previewMessage: Some beautiful things take time to open. May you be loved with patience and kindness, and always know that I am here.
templates.mot-ky-niem.previewMessage: I still remember that moment and the peace of having you beside me. May we have many more days to look back on and smile.
templates.new-year-spark-2027.previewMes: Here is to 2027! May the new year bring you good health, warm reunions, and the courage to begin what you have been dreaming of.
templates.peachy-day.previewMessage: A little sweetness for an ordinary day. May you find time for what you love and someone to share the small joys with.
templates.polaroid.previewMessage: A little moment, a memory all our own. Thank you for being there with me. Looking back still makes me smile.
templates.spring-blessing-2027.previewMe: Wishing you and your family a peaceful, healthy new year filled with reunions. May the things you have cared for blossom this spring.
templates.starlight.previewMessage: Among all the vast things in the world, there is still a patch of sky just for you. May your wish find its way in its own time.
templates.sunny-wishes.previewMessage: Wishing you a sunny birthday and happy little plans. May your new year bring places to go, people to love, and reasons to smile.
templates.thank-you-bloom.previewMessage: Thank you for being there when I needed you most. Your kindness made the difficult days feel lighter. I will always appreciate it.
templates.tiny-celebration.previewMessag: Celebrating your special day with a little joy and a lot of love. May you always find something to look forward to.
templates.velvet-valentine-2027.previewM: To the one I love, thank you for the little things that warm every day. Here is to many more seasons of love together.
templates.winter-wishes-2026.previewMess: May this winter bring you a warm place to return to and the company of those you love. Wishing you a peaceful holiday season.
templates.loi-moi-ben-hien.previewMessag: Come celebrate with us and add your story to the day. Having you here will make it warmer and more memorable.
templates.cuon-phim-ngay-ay.previewMessa: Every photo keeps a story, and I keep the joy of having you in it. Here is to making more memories together.
templates.ban-do-ngay-ra-truong.previewM: Congratulations on reaching this milestone! May your next journey bring things to learn, people to trust, and the confidence to choose your own path.
